the location of maximum temperature is mainly affected by the ReH, Pr, Ncc and mode of heat generating (uniform or non uniform) and the maximum temperature of the plates is reduced when spacing (B) is increased, while the ReH and Ncc play major role in increasing the maximum temperature.
the hotspots location in the heat generating vertical parallel plate is mainly affected by the ReH, mode of heat generation and B.

the maximum temperature is mainly affected by the Reynolds Number, Prandtl Number, Conduction Convection Parameter, and Heat Generation Parameter, and the location of hotspots is mainly affected by Reynolds Number, Pr, Ncc, and mode of heat Generation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the conjugate heat transfer in a vertical parallel plates with non uniform heating, which is a very important problem in many industrial applications.
the determination of hotspots location and hotspots temperature in a vertical parallel plate channel.
the effect of operational parameters on the hot spots temperature and location in heat generating vertical parallel plates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
for a given set of parameters the maximum temperature (hot spot) is found at the center of the plate when the plate are placed at optimum distance (Bopt).
for a particular set of parameters (ReH, Qt, Ncc, Pr and B) the hot spots temperature can be reduced by increasing the spacing between the parallel plates.
the location of the hot spot is mainly governed by the Reynolds number, and the temperature is mainly influenced by the spacing between the parallel plates.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
for uniform heat generation, the location of hot spots is independent of B, ReH and Pr while for non-uniform heat generation the location of hotspots is dependent on B, ReH, Pr, and Ncc.
the location of maximum temperature (Hot spot location) is found to be independent of spacing (B) and Pr.
the hot spot temperature and location is affected by the operational parameters and the spacing between the plate is the most important factor in reducing the hot spot temperature.

the hot spots location is mainly affected by the mode of heat generation and ReH.
